label: decay-03a-run
surface: Field's run command on the box (through the backdoor)

facts.source:
# Heat follows outward travel
input z
0.65 /
0 max
1 min
smooth
# Dark iron to incandescent orange
[1.355,0.23,-0.037,0] *
[0.045,0.05,0.055,0] +
# Host polygon radius: zero at centre, one at the real perimeter
input w
# Deep, stable tears in the remaining rim
input xy
13 *
fbm
0.42 *
+
0.015 +
# Eat most of the interior while far out; fully heal on return
input z
0.65 /
0.55 -
0.30 /
0 max
1 min
smooth
1.07 *
-
# Keep a narrow outer thread even at the deepest tears
input w
0.975 -
max
# Host discards alpha below 0.5
10 *
0.5 +
[0,0,0,1] *
+
host: fragment:10: // face_decay(vec4(place on the face xy, outward travel, polygon radius)):
fragment:16: vec4 d = face_decay(vec4(vLocal.xy * 3.0 + 0.5, vAway, vRadius));
facts.hostMeaning: The host shader calls face_decay(vec4) and uses what it returns; its input and the use of its output are in these lines, not in StackSL's own frame.
knobs: k0 L3:1 0.65 → safe divide b [heat color range]
k1 L4:1 0 → max b [minimum heat color]
k2 L5:1 1 → min b [maximum heat color]
k3 L8:2 [1.355,0.23,-0.037,0] → multiply b [red heat brightness]
k4 L8:8 [1.355,0.23,-0.037,0] → multiply b [green heat brightness]
k5 L8:13 [1.355,0.23,-0.037,0] → multiply b [blue heat brightness]
k6 L8:20 [1.355,0.23,-0.037,0] → multiply b [heat opacity]
k7 L9:2 [0.045,0.05,0.055,0] → add b [red iron brightness]
k8 L9:8 [0.045,0.05,0.055,0] → add b [green iron brightness]
k9 L9:13 [0.045,0.05,0.055,0] → add b [blue iron brightness]
k11 L14:1 13 → multiply b [tear pattern scale]
k12 L16:1 0.42 → multiply b [rim tear depth]
k13 L18:1 0.015 → add b [rim tear baseline]
k14 L21:1 0.65 → safe divide b [healing distance scale]
k15 L22:1 0.55 → subtract b [healing distance threshold]
k16 L23:1 0.30 → safe divide b [healing transition width]
k17 L24:1 0 → max b [minimum interior erosion]
k18 L25:1 1 → min b [maximum interior erosion]
k19 L27:1 1.07 → multiply b [interior erosion depth]
k20 L31:1 0.975 → subtract b [outer thread radius]
k21 L34:1 10 → multiply b [rim opacity strength]
k22 L35:1 0.5 → add b [rim opacity threshold]
k23 L36:2 [0,0,0,1] → multiply b [rim red channel]
k24 L36:8 [0,0,0,1] → multiply b [rim opacity]

history.description: the slot's program as the box bound it
Distance-driven hot metal: dark iron at home, bright orange at full extension
Ragged interior burn-through near maximum travel, healing on return; preserve iron-to-orange heat
Much larger peak burn with coarse, deep torn edges and full healing at home
Widen peak openings further and sustain the torn-metal phase around maximum extension
